name: Build (Manual)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install strip-nondeterminism
      run: sudo apt-get install strip-nondeterminism
    - name: Install Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 24
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci --loglevel=info
    - name: Fetch
      run: npm run fetch
    - name: Compile
      run: npm run webpack:prod
    - name: Package
      run: |
        node release-automation/build.mjs --debian --tarball --appimage --x64 --armv7l --arm64
    - name: Print file tree
      run: node scripts/print-file-tree.mjs dist
    - name: Upload artifacts to GitHub Actions
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: linux
        path: |
          dist/*.deb
          dist/*.tar.gz
          dist/*.AppImage

  build-mac:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 24
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci --loglevel=info
    - name: Fetch
      run: npm run fetch
    - name: Compile
      run: npm run webpack:prod
    - name: Package
      run: |
        # Need to run the universal builds as separate commands or it breaks when @electron/universal
        # diffs the ASARs and finds spurious differences. Not clear why.
        node release-automation/build.mjs --mac --universal --production
        node release-automation/build.mjs --mac-legacy-11 --universal --production
        node release-automation/build.mjs --mac-legacy-10.13-10.14 --mac-legacy-10.15 --x64
    - name: Print file tree
      run: node scripts/print-file-tree.mjs dist
    - name: Upload artifacts to GitHub Actions
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: mac
        path: dist/*.dmg

  build-windows:
    # GitHub's Windows runners have a C: drive and a D: drive.
    # C: is for the OS and has good read performance but awful write performance.
    # D: has much better faster write performance (>20x faster than C:)
    # We want to use the D: drive whenever we can. Trying to do "npm ci" on the C:
    # drive has been observed to take over an hour!
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    # actions/checkout can only clone to paths in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE which is on the C: drive,
    # so we have to clone to C: then copy to D: after. This repository itself isn't huge so
    # this is plenty fast.
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        persist-credentials: false
        path: repo
    - name: "Move repository to D: drive"
      run: |
        Copy-Item -Path repo -Destination D:\repo -Recurse
        Remove-Item -Path repo -Recurse -Force
    - name: Install Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 24
    # The repository being on D: means that node_modules IO will be fast, but npm still downloads
    # packages to a temporary folder for caching which is on C: by default. We need to make sure
    # npm uses the D: drive instead otherwise we still get bottlenecked by C:.
    - name: "Configure npm to use D: drive"
      run: |
        npm config s

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
